finding: Installed MMEngine IterTimerHook subtracts time.time() (realtime clock). A negative elapsed value reflects a realtime clock discontinuity; the specific host/WSL cause was not independently diagnosed. Subsequent reported iteration times returned to positive values.
impact: No training/model/config changes. Learning rate is iteration-indexed. Formal entry wall times use time.monotonic(); RoadAuditHook uses time.perf_counter() for train/validation resource timing. Do not use framework realtime log ETA as the definitive experiment duration.
